description.content: Fetch a list of all supported Banks for your application, includes status and configuration information.

query.description: Scopes the returned banks to those enabled for the given customer. Used to control bank rollout on a per-customer basis, so that newly onboarded banks can be exposed to selected customers before being made generally available.
Specifies whether the Entity is a Retail or Corporate owned account.
